name: What preparations should I make before structural remodeling begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before structural remodeling begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before structural remodeling begins, you should prepare by clearing out the work area, removing furniture, and protecting items that cannot be moved. It's also important to discuss and understand the project schedule, potential disruptions to utilities, and dust control measures with your contractor. Ensuring access for workers and materials is key. Gathering all necessary documents, such as your property survey and any existing structural plans, can also help streamline the initial stages and prevent delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, discussing the schedule and utility disruptions with your contractor, and ensuring access. Gather property documents if available.
